posts.name: Jatin Nahata
posts.cooked:
I got mail as “Optional SCT Attendance – Response Required Only If Interested”

I dont get any mail regarding mandatory sct or any meet link
According to what i remember my last SCT a year back in Sept24
and what i know is SCT is valid till 1 year.

I am travelling from 26 september to 1 october because of urgent checkup,
so please clarify wheather, I have to give SCT or not, as soon as possible.

Also I create ticket for the same.
@Bharathi @satyanarayana

posts.name: Mrinal
posts.cooked: As mentioned in the mail subject, SCT is optional for you.

posts.name: Jatin Nahata
posts.cooked:
Soo its okay if i wont give it.
I am worried about it as I havent attended SCT from last 3 terms

Thanks for clarification.
Regards

posts.name: Mrinal
posts.cooked: You need not worry about this. They would have mailed you, if you were needed to do SCT again.
